CrmWrites.reason: A share names a stored record, and a write touches only its author company records and shares: what the writing section says.

content.statement: The store is the CRM's records and shares; a write is a user's change; a store is consistent when every share is of a stored record; a write may change only its author's company's records, and add or remove only shares of their company's records.
content.why: A share of a record that is not stored would show nothing, or the next record stored with that id. Authority is by the author's account, which authentication provides (not modelled). Records of other companies must come out of a write exactly as they went in.
substitutions: consistent := (s: CrmStore) => s.shares.forall(sh => s.records.exists(r => r.id == sh.record))

permitted := (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd, t: CrmStore) =>
    t.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) == s.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) &&
    t.shares.forall(sh => s.shares.contains(sh) || t.records.exists(r => r.id == sh.record && r.tenant == w.by.tenant)) &&
    s.shares.forall(sh => t.shares.contains(sh) || s.records.exists(r => r.id == sh.record && r.tenant == w.by.tenant))

enum Kind: case Contact, case Deal
case class CrmRecord(id_: Long, tenant: TenantId, kind: Kind, title: String)
case class Share(record: Long, to: TenantId)
case class CrmStore(records: List[CrmRecord], shares: List[Share])
case class Account(email: String, tenant: TenantId)
enum Change: case Add(record: CrmRecord), case ShareWith(record: Long, to: TenantId), case Unshare(record: Long, to: TenantId)
case class WriteCmd(«by»: Account, change: Change)
keeps: NoCrossTenantRead: exempt, because a write returns the store to the system, not records to a reader
content.implementation:
proven: applyWrite
applyWrite = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) =>
      if r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id) then s.copy(records = s.records ++ List(r)) else s
    case Change.ShareWith(id, to) =>
      if s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then s.copy(shares = s.shares ++ List(Share(id, to))) else s
    case Change.Unshare(id, to) =>
      if s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then s.copy(shares = s.shares.filter(sh => sh != Share(id, to))) else s

content.idea:
# CRM

Many companies use one CRM. Each company's users manage contacts and deals.

## Writing records

A user adds records for their company, and shares or unshares their company's
records with other companies. No write changes another company's records, or
adds or removes a share of a record the author's company does not own. Every
share is of a stored record.
